rca_of_issue: Reproduction: on phone viewport 390x844, fill New Walk-in fields, choose department, then tap `Log Walk-in`. In 3 attempts, URL remained /walkins/new and backend logs did not show POST /api/walkins for those submit attempts. Meanwhile duplicate-check GETs did occur, proving API reachability/session were active. Likely root cause is mobile interaction/layout around bottom CTA zone (bottom nav/FAB overlap or tap interception), not backend create logic (which is green in pytest).
